claire: Short thread  we need a tight benchmark narrative for the product launch. Focus: p95 latency vs $/1k token tradeoff, and a simple routing diagram for inbound leads. Want one hero chart for the blog, one detailed heatmap for the webinar appendix.
aj: For hero, recommend a scatter with callouts for three archetypes: chat (interactive), summarization (throughput), embeddings (bulk). Keep axis labels plain language (Latency (ms), Cost ($/1k tokens)). Add dotted price bands for Hosted vs Dedicated.
sam: Webinar idea: show heatmap (batch size x seq len -> $/token) and an animation or step slide that shows caching and batching reducing cost while keeping latency SLOs. Also include a short demo snippet for the landing.
kevin: Data provenance: must include region (us-east-1), model (rw-3B q4f), quantization notes, sample sizes. Mark any synthetic workloads clearly. Also confirm pricing includes amortized infra and support overheads.
claire: Social hooks (short): "Serve predictably. Spend sensibly." or "Serving economics unlocked." Use the first for PLG.
aj: Owners: aj = blog + hero chart, sam = webinar heatmap + demo snippet, kevin = data validation, claire = social + landing copy. Deadlines: hero draft by EOD tomorrow, heatmap by Wed, landing + lead flow by Fri.
dev-bot: https://docs.internal/redwood/benchmarks/us-east1-launch (sheet uploaded)
claire: Quick agreement? :thumbsup:
